title: solid-panes manifest
description: Registry entry mapping a urn:solid type to a pane + schema pair. One file per type.

term.description: The urn:solid: identifier this entry handles.

termRegistry.description: URL of the term in the urn-solid registry.

pane.description: URL of an ES module that exports a LOSOS-shaped pane (default export with render/canHandle).

schema.description: URL of a JSON Schema describing well-formed data of this type. Optional — schema-style panes need it; bespoke panes may not.

label.description: Human-readable label for the type (used by the pane tab).

description.description: One-line description of what this pane renders.

alsoHandles.description: Additional urn:solid: types this pane should be invoked for. Lets one pane serve multiple closely-related types.
